mapper.select:
select -- 主表：sys_user（基础账号信息） user.username as username, user.phone as phone, user.bio as bio, user.avatar_file_id as avatarFileId, user.avatar_color as avatarColor,
-- VIP 状态（数据库时间戳 → 布尔值） user.vip_expire_time as vipExpireTime, case when user.vip_expire_time >= now() then 1 else 0 end as vip,
-- 扩展表：sys_user_profile（作家资料） profile.pen_name as penName, profile.creation_dir as creationDir, profile.masterpiece as masterpiece
from sys_user user
left join sys_user_profile profile on user.id = profile.user_id
where user.id = #{id} and user.del_flag = 0

select -- 主表：sys_user（基础账号信息） user.username as username, user.phone as phone, user.bio as bio, user.avatar_file_id as avatarFileId, user.avatar_color as avatarColor,
-- VIP 状态 user.vip_expire_time as vipExpireTime, case when user.vip_expire_time >= now() then 1 else 0 end as vip,
-- 非作者无扩展表，显式置空（保证 VO 字段存在且不报错） null as penName, null as creationDir, null as masterpiece
from sys_user user
where user.id = #{id} and user.del_flag = 0
